target_fidelity.note: Present simple, active, positive polar question with no modal.

naturalness.note: The prompt and response are coherent and natural.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It clearly practices present-simple yes/no question formation.

determinacy.note: The supplied words and prompt determine the intended response.
